subject: Audit & Access Logs — region-scoped export windows and deletion assurances

We're working through our evidence requirements for an upcoming EU audit and need a clear description of two things for your hosted service:

1) Can Redwood produce time-bounded extracts of access/audit logs that are limited to EU-resident tenants only (i.e., exclude cross-border metadata)? If so, what formats are supported and how are credentials delivered?

2) What are the standard retention periods for access logs and the supported retention tiers (90 days, 1 year, 7 years)? If a customer needs a 7-year retention that is still served from Redwood's hosted offering, what is the recommended path?

Also please confirm whether Redwood can provide a deletion attestation once an export and subsequent retention teardown are complete.

Attaching our audit checklist for reference (not expecting you to fill it out).

Hi Lara,

Thanks for the questions — below is a concise runbook-style answer to each point. I'm keeping it high-level; we can share a redacted example bundle and the manifest if you want to validate field names.

1) Region-scoped extracts
- Hosted tenants: We support region-scoped exports for tenants flagged as EU-resident. The export process filters by tenant metadata and origin region so the bundle only includes events produced by EU-region hosts.
- Delivery modes: signed S3 presigned URL (hosted in EU region when requested), encrypted ZIP delivered over an EU-located SFTP, or an e2e-encrypted artifact on a customer-managed bucket (customer supplies write access). We can avoid non-EU transit if the delivery target is EU-located.
- Format: NDJSON (preferred for line-delimited processing), gzipped CSV (for BI teams), or a compressed JSONL bundle. Each bundle contains a manifest (example attached) with start/end timestamps, shard identifiers, event counts, and a SHA256 checksum per file.

2) Retention tiers and recommendations
- Default hosted retention: 90 days for access logs on the standardHosted tier.
- Extended retention (hosted): We offer managed extended retention add-ons — 1 year and up to 3 years — for hosted customers via a reserved-tier archive (cold storage on regional blobs).
- 7-year retention: For legal holds or industry-regulated archives requiring 7 years, we recommend one of two approaches:
  a) Dedicated/Private deployment: Provision Redwood Dedicated in an EU-only capacity with retention configured to 7 years (preferred for strict residency and SLA guarantees).
  b) Hosted + External Archive: Export periodic snapshots (monthly or quarterly) to a customer-controlled EU storage account; Redwood can automate exports and lifecycle rules. Note: hosted long-term retention beyond 3 years requires contract amendment and capacity planning.

3) Deletion attestation and post-export teardown
- We produce an export manifest and a signed delivery receipt when the bundle is published.
- For deletion of Redwood copies after export and teardown, we provide a deletion certification that includes: manifest of exported files, confirmation of internal wipe steps, and purge timestamps.
- Practical note: physical and backup propagation means that final irrevocable deletion can take up to 30 days across our storage tiers; we include this window in the attestation.

SLA / timing
- Standard export request: 3–5 business days for a scoped export (depending on time range and retention tier).
- Expedited export: 24–48 hours with enterprise priority (subject to capacity).

Privacy and PII
- If you require PII removal/redaction prior to export, we can apply field-level redaction rules, but this is a manual configuration step and may add to export lead time.

I'll attach the export spec and an example manifest (see Jonas' message). Marissa can follow up with pricing and the contract amendment path if you want the hosted extended retention.

-Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Hi Lara — action items and commercial notes:

- If you want EU-resident exports only and a certified 7-year retention, we recommend Dedicated in-region. I'll attach a short quote addendum for a 7-year retention SLA.
- Hosted extended retention (1–3 years) is available via a monthly tiered fee; I can get precise numbers once you confirm the average daily log volume and desired retention window.
- For the export itself, we will:
  1) Produce NDJSON bundles with a manifest (sha256 + shard ids).
  2) Deliver to your EU S3 bucket if provided, or generate an EU-presigned URL limited to 72 hours.
  3) Provide deletion attestation within 30 days of your confirmation to purge.
